A dog is one of the most loyal and friendly animals. Dogs are often called “man’s best friend” because they love and protect their owners. They come in many breeds, sizes, and colors. Some dogs guard homes, while others help police officers, farmers, or disabled people. Dogs are intelligent animals and can learn many tricks and commands. They enjoy playing, running, and spending time with humans. A dog needs proper food, clean water, exercise, and care to stay healthy. Many families keep dogs as pets because they bring happiness, companionship, and security. Dogs truly make our lives better and more joyful.
